verdict.rationale: New Relic documents AI-powered summaries of workload health, performance trends and potential issues [new-relic-docs-43]. It also documents an AI assistant for troubleshooting issues in plain language [new-relic-docs-9]. Both sit next to the story, but neither explicitly summarizes alert incidents or packages alert context for responders. missing for 10: explicit AI-generated incident/alert summaries attached to alert notifications or issues, documentation of responder-facing incident context, independent or hands-on corroboration.
